svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Rounded $0 Local mark, v3
svg.desc: The Gentle Ticket variant from v2 continues with a proper Arial Bold $0. The capsule end, right-facing tag point, and attached local pin-base preserve its softer character. The lower pointer is aligned and attached, with a circular opening to signal local discovery. Original, unadopted logo concept; lettering is editable.
